feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Iteration 2 (array at y = 0.055 m, 50 mm span) reduced line loss on the s-bend and slalom from 1.0 to 1.0 (no change) and left the oval at 2.0 events, so the forward move helped less than hoped. Max_error stayed between 0.061 and 0.069, still above the 0.06 m limit, and progress reached only 0.11 to 0.22. Steering_oscillation stayed low (0.14 to 0.21), so the gains are not the problem. I kept your y = 0.065 m and the 50 mm span, with the controller unchanged. Next race: if line_loss_events is still at least 1 on any track, move the array to about y = 0.075 m, which is near the top of the allowed range, and keep the span. If line loss is 0 on all tracks but max_error stays at or above 0.06, the limit is turning authority, so narrow wheel_track. Keep body_width at 0.12 m, since the off-track limit is already at its 0.06 m floor.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events is still at least 1 on any development track at y = 0.065 m, move the array forward to about y = 0.075 m, keeping the 50 mm span (iteration 2 at y = 0.055 m still gave 1 to 2 events per track).
If line_loss_events drops to 0 but max_error stays at or above 0.06, reduce wheel_track from 0.12 m to about 0.10 m for more turn rate (iteration 2 max_error was 0.061 to 0.069).
Keep body_width at 0.12 m; the off-track limit is already at its 0.06 m floor, so widening the body does not change the outcome (iteration 2 max_error sat at the limit on all tracks).
